Name: FXTrader
Author: xinhai61435
Description:
[size=5]简介 / Description[/size]

把星露谷物语变成一间外汇交易大厅。

价格每 3 秒跳动一次，K 线在图表上实时生长。你可以用最高 50 倍杠杆做多或做空 8 个货币对，浮亏吃光保证金就当场爆仓——哪怕你正在外面钓鱼。

灵感来自网页游戏 [url=https://www.bilibili.com/toy/fx-simple/index.html]FX 简单![/url]。

交易是要花掉你的白天的。交易终端是全游戏唯一不暂停时间的菜单，所以你盯着图表的时候，这一天照样在流逝。

Turn Stardew Valley into a forex trading floor.

Prices tick every 3 seconds. K-line candles grow in real time on the chart. You can go long or short 8 currency pairs with up to 50x leverage, and if your floating loss eats your margin you get liquidated on the spot — even while you are out fishing.

Inspired by the browser game [url=https://www.bilibili.com/toy/fx-simple/index.html]FX 简单![/url].

Trading costs you daylight. The trading terminal is the one menu in the game that does [b]not[/b] pause the clock, so the day keeps moving while you stare at the chart.

[*]用 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]游戏内按 [b]X[/b] 打开交易终端。

[list]
[*]点左侧的货币对切换图表[/*]

[*]选杠杆：1x / 2x / 5x / 10x / 20x / 50x[/*]
[*][b]做多 BUY[/b] 赌价格上涨，[b]做空 SELL[/b] 赌价格下跌[/*]
[*][b]平仓[/b] 或 [b]全部平仓[/b] 结算盈亏并返还金币[/*]

[*][b]Esc[/b] 关闭终端——价格仍在跳动[/*]
[/list]按键可以在 [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] 里改（见下）。

[size=5]主要特性 / Main features[/size]

[list]
[*][b]8 个货币对[/b] — USD/CNY、EUR/USD、GBP/USD、USD/JPY、AUD/USD、USD/CAD、USD/CHF、NZD/USD[/*]
[*][b]每 tick 一根蜡烛[/b] — 每 3 秒的每次价格变化都成为一根独立蜡烛，图表向右滚动[/*]
[*][b]真实起始汇率[/b] — 起始价取自 frankfurter.dev（欧洲央行官方参考汇率），之后由游戏内市场接管[/*]
[*][b]保证金交易[/b] — 1 到 50 倍杠杆，可做多做空，随时平仓[/*]
[*][b]实时爆仓[/b] — 每个 tick 都检查，不是一天才查一次[/*]
[*][b]后台运行[/b] — 关掉终端价格照样跳，回来时账户可能已经爆了[/*]
[*][b]时间照走[/b] — 交易终端是唯一不暂停游戏时钟的菜单，交易要花掉你的白天[/*]
[*][b]存档持久化[/b] — 价格、持仓、盈亏、K 线历史全部写入存档[/*]
[*][b]中英双语[/b] — 自动跟随游戏语言[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]8 currency pairs[/b] — USD/CNY, EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, AUD/USD, USD/CAD, USD/CHF, NZD/USD[/*]
[*][b]One candle per tick[/b] — every 3 seconds each price change becomes its own candle, and the chart scrolls to the right[/*]
[*][b]Real starting rates[/b] — prices are seeded from frankfurter.dev (official European Central Bank reference rates). After seeding, the in-game market takes over[/*]
[*][b]Margin trading[/b] — 1x to 50x leverage, long or short, close any time[/*]
[*][b]Real-time liquidation[/b] — checked on every tick, not just once a day[/*]
[*][b]Runs in the background[/b] — prices keep ticking even when the terminal is closed, so you can come back to a blown account[/*]
[*][b]Time keeps flowing[/b] — the trading terminal is the one menu that does not pause the game clock, so trading costs you daylight[/*]
[*][b]Save persistence[/b] — prices, positions, P/L and candle history all stored in your save[/*]
[*][b]English and Chinese[/b] — follows your game language automatically[/*]
[/list][size=5]交易规则 / Trading rules[/size]

[code]
名义 Notional    = 保证金 margin x 杠杆 leverage
敞口 Exposure    = 名义 / 开仓价  (价格每变动 1.0 时的金币盈亏)
盈亏 P/L        = 方向 x (现价 - 开仓价) x 敞口
爆仓 Liquidation = 浮亏 >= 保证金  ->  强制平仓，保证金没收[/code]敞口按你的[b]开仓价[/b]换算，所以你选的杠杆就是你真正拿到的杠杆，跟交易哪个货币对无关。价格反向动 1%，你亏掉保证金的 1% x 杠杆。

举例：1000 金币保证金、50x 杠杆，名义 50,000 金币。价格动 1% 值 500 金币（你保证金的一半），动 2% 就归零。一个 tick 大约动 0.12%，所以 50x 下连续约 17 个坏 tick 就会爆仓。

[code]
1x = 100%    5x = 20%    20x =  5%
2x =  50%  10x = 10%    50x =  2%[/code]Exposure is converted [b]at your entry price[/b], so the leverage you pick is the leverage you actually get, no matter which pair you trade. A 1% adverse move costs you 1% x leverage of your margin.

Example: 1000g margin at 50x gives 50,000g notional. A 1% move is worth 500g (half your margin) and a 2% move wipes you out. One tick moves roughly 0.12%, so about 17 bad ticks in a row at 50x will liquidate you.

[code]
1x = 100%    5x = 20%    20x =  5%
2x =  50%  10x = 10%    50x =  2%[/code][size=5]前置要求 / Requirements[/size]

[/list]支持 Windows、Linux、macOS。支持单人和多人——每个玩家有自己的持仓。

[size=5]配置 / Configuration[/size]

首次运行会在 [font=Courier New]Mods/FXTrader/[/font] 生成 [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]：

[code]
{
  "UseLiveData": true,          // 用 frankfurter (ECB) 播种起始价
  "TickIntervalSeconds": 3.0,    // 价格跳动间隔（秒）
  "TickVolatility": 0.0012,      // 每 tick 波动幅度（0.0012 = 0.12%）
  "RefreshMinutes": 30,          // 汇率刷新间隔（分钟）
  "OpenKey": "X"                // 打开交易终端的按键
}[/code]装了 Generic Mod Config Menu 的话可以在游戏内改这些设置。

A [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] is created in [font=Courier New]Mods/FXTrader/[/font] on first run:

[code]
{
  "UseLiveData": true,          // seed prices from frankfurter (ECB)
  "TickIntervalSeconds": 3.0,    // how often prices tick
  "TickVolatility": 0.0012,      // swing per tick (0.0012 = 0.12%)
  "RefreshMinutes": 30,          // rate refresh interval
  "OpenKey": "X"                // key to open the terminal
}[/code]If you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed you can edit these in game.

[size=5]说明与限制 / Notes and limitations[/size]

[list]
[*]ECB 参考汇率每个工作日只更新一次，所以"真实汇率"只用来给起始价播种。之后每 tick 的波动是游戏内市场——否则就没东西可交易了。[/*]
[*]交易终端[b]不[/b]暂停游戏时钟。其他菜单（背包、对话、发货箱）仍然照常暂停时间。[/*]
[*]保证金在你开仓那一刻检查，不会因为之后金币变化重新校验。[/*]
[*]爆仓会立刻弹出 HUD 提示，并在第二天寄一封汇总信。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]ECB reference rates update once per business day, so the "real rate" only seeds the starting price. The per-tick movement is the in-game market — otherwise there would be nothing to trade.[/*]
[*]The trading terminal does [b]not[/b] pause the game clock. Every other menu (inventory, dialogue, shipping bin) still pauses time as usual.[/*]
[*]Margin is checked at the moment you open a position, not re-validated against later gold changes.[/*]
[*]Liquidation shows a HUD alert immediately and also sends a summary letter the next day.[/*]
